items.source: The userName and password are configured in your Couchbase Server cluster through RBAC (role-based access control). The bucketName reflects the bucket you want to use for this configuration.
items.translation:
`userName` 和 `password` 已通过基于角色的访问控制（RBAC）在您的 Couchbase Server 集群中进行配置。  
`bucketName` 反映了您希望为此配置所使用的桶（bucket）。

items.source: The connection string is made up of a list of hosts and an optional scheme (couchbase://) as shown in the code above. All you need to provide is a list of Couchbase nodes to bootstrap into (separated by a ,). Please note that while one host is sufficient in development, it is recommended to add 3 to 5 bootstrap nodes here. Couchbase will pick up all nodes from the cluster automatically, but it could be the case that the only node you’ve provided is experiencing issues while you are starting the application.
items.translation: 连接字符串由主机列表和可选的协议（couchbase://）组成，如上代码所示。您只需提供一个用于引导加入的 Couchbase 节点列表（用 , 分隔）。请注意，虽然在开发环境中一个主机就足够了，但建议在此处添加 3 到 5 个引导节点。Couchbase 会自动从集群中获取所有节点，但在启动应用程序时，您提供的唯一节点可能会出现问题的情况。

items.source: Some users may wish to use a Couchbase Java SDK version different from the one referenced in a Spring Data Couchbase release for the purpose of obtaining bug and vulnerability fixes.  Since Couchbase Java SDK minor version releases are backwards compatible, this version of Spring Data Couchbase is compatible and supported with any 3.x version of the Couchbase Java SDK newer than the one specified in the release dependencies.  To change the Couchbase Java SDK version used by Spring Data Couchbase, simply override the dependency in the application pom.xml as follows:

Once you have all needed dependencies on the classpath, you can start configuring it.
Only Java config is supported (XML config has been removed in 4.0).
items.translation: 配置完类路径上所需的所有依赖后，即可开始进行配置。仅支持 Java 配置（4.0 版本已移除 XML 配置）。

Many more things can be customized and overridden as custom beans from this configuration (for example repositories,
validation and custom converters).
items.translation: 从该配置中还可以自定义和覆盖更多内容作为自定义 Bean（例如仓库、验证器和自定义转换器）。

items.source:
If you start your application, you should see Couchbase INFO level logging in the logs, indicating that the underlying
Couchbase Java SDK is connecting to the database.If any errors are reported, make sure that the given credentials
and host information are correct.
items.translation: 启动应用程序后，您应在日志中看到 Couchbase 的 INFO 级别日志，表明底层的 Couchbase Java SDK 正在连接数据库。如果报告了任何错误，请确保提供的凭据和主机信息正确无误。

items.source:
To leverage multi-bucket repositories, implement the methods below in your Config class.
The config*OperationsMapping methods configure the mapping of entity-objects to buckets.
Be careful with the method names - using a method name that is a Bean will result in the value of that bean being used instead of the result of the method.
items.translation:
要在多桶存储库中利用其功能，请在您的 Config 类中实现以下方法。  
config*OperationsMapping 方法用于配置实体对象到桶的映射关系。  
请注意方法命名——如果方法名与某个 Bean 相同，系统将使用该 Bean 的值而非方法的返回值。

items.source:
This example maps Person → protected, User → mybucket, and everything else goes to getBucketName().

items.translation: 此示例将 Person 映射到 protected，User 映射到 mybucket，其余内容则调用 getBucketName()。请注意，此映射仅适用于通过 Repository 进行的调用。

items.source: If you use SyncGateway and CouchbaseMobile, you may run into problem with fields prefixed by _. Since Spring Data Couchbase by default stores the type information as a _class attribute this can be problematic. Override typeKey() (for example to return MappingCouchbaseConverter.TYPEKEY_SYNCGATEWAY_COMPATIBLE) to change the name of said attribute.
items.translation: 如果您使用 SyncGateway 和 CouchbaseMobile，可能会遇到以 _ 开头的字段引发的问题。由于 Spring Data Couchbase 默认将类型信息存储为 _class 属性，这可能会导致问题。请重写 typeKey() 方法（例如返回 MappingCouchbaseConverter.TYPEKEY_SYNCGATEWAY_COMPATIBLE），以更改该属性的名称。
